scripts.tauri:dev:opencv: OLCR_PYTHON="${OLCR_PYTHON:-$PWD/../.venv312/bin/python}" OLCR_BACKEND_DIR="${OLCR_BACKEND_DIR:-$PWD/../backend}" sh -c 'XCODE_DEV_DIR="$(xcode-select -p)"; export DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH="$XCODE_DEV_DIR/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/lib/swift-5.5/macosx:$XCODE_DEV_DIR/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/lib${DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH}"; export OPENCV_LINK_LIBS=opencv_video,opencv_features,opencv_imgproc,opencv_geometry,opencv_flann,opencv_core; cd ../desktop && ../frontend/node_modules/.bin/tauri dev --features opencv-perception'
scripts.tauri:build:opencv: OLCR_PYTHON="${OLCR_PYTHON:-$PWD/../.venv312/bin/python}" OLCR_BACKEND_DIR="${OLCR_BACKEND_DIR:-$PWD/../backend}" sh -c 'OLCR_API_REPAIR_BUILD_ID="${OLCR_API_REPAIR_BUILD_ID:-olcr-opencv-build-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-$$}"; export OLCR_API_REPAIR_BUILD_ID; XCODE_DEV_DIR="$(xcode-select -p)"; export DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH="$XCODE_DEV_DIR/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/lib/swift-5.5/macosx:$XCODE_DEV_DIR/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/lib${DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$DYLD_FALLBACK_LIBRARY_PATH}"; export DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH="$XCODE_DEV_DIR/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/lib${DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH}"; export OPENCV_LINK_LIBS=opencv_video,opencv_features,opencv_imgproc,opencv_geometry,opencv_flann,opencv_core; if [ -n "${OLCR_CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-}" ]; then export CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$OLCR_CARGO_TARGET_DIR"; fi; npm run build && cd ../desktop/src-tauri && cargo build --release --features opencv-perception,custom-protocol && cd .. && ../frontend/node_modules/.bin/tauri bundle --bundles app && python3 ../scripts/bundle_opencv_macos.py "${OLCR_OPENCV_APP_PATH:-src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/OLCR.app}"'
